name: @vostok/patterns
description: The repeating-pattern engine: procedural tiles and fields (Japanese, Islamic, lattices, living hinges, radial, engrave fills) plus SVG tile import, filled into any shape and emitted as laser cut-outs, score lines or engraved regions. Pure TypeScript on the shape maths of @vostok/shapes, millimetres, Y up.
